#### Welcome to SA2B Speedrunning!

### Listed below are descriptions of concepts, terms and rules that you may need to understand each Category’s individual rulesets.

##### IGT and the Autosplitter

- Several categories are ranked based on their Time Without Loads (Loadless) as displayed by the game. 
- On PC, there is an Autosplitter that tracks your Loadless automatically. More info here: http://www.speedrun.com/sa2b/guide/fabjo
- On Console, or if you’re unable to use LiveSplit’s Autosplitter functionality, you need to calculate your Loadless manually. More info here: http://www.speedrun.com/sa2b/guide/uw9lv

##### File Types [NG/NG+]

- New Game and New Game+ are differentiated by the type of file that they are completed from. A New Game run must be completed from a Fresh File, while a New Game+ run must be completed from a Completed File.
- A “Fresh File” is a newly created File that does not have any progress made on it. In order to set up a Fresh File, one must do so in the Settings, or the File Select Screen.
- A “Completed File” is one that has already been made, and therefore already has made progress in the game. This means that any upgrades are allowed, you may start with more than 4 lives, and Stage Select can be fully unlocked, as well as any alternative Karts or Costumes.

##### Thresholds

- In order to increase the accessibility of the game’s most popular categories, video is often not required until a runner’s pb reaches a certain benchmark. Due to speedrun.com’s organization system, any run that has Loadless will be placed above every run that does not. For this reason, we remove the Loadless of all runs that do not surpass the Threshold, regardless of if they are submitted with Loadless, so that the leaderboard remains properly ordered at every rank. Each category’s Threshold can be found in their Rules.

##### Video Requirements

- Runs that require video would ideally be submitted via a website such as YouTube. Twitch VODs and Clips are allowed as well, but due to past issues YouTube is preferred.
- Please refrain from uploading your video proof to websites such as Streamable, Tiktok, Instagram, Twitter, FaceBook, etc. as they are not accessible in all regions and may get automatically deleted after some time has passed.

##### Frame Rate

- The game should be played as close to 60fps as possible. If the run has significant frame drops the Mod Team reserves the right to reject it.

##### Emulators & ISO Loading

- All emulators are banned.
- For console categories that use loadless: using a USB/SD card loader, an optical drive emulator, or playing on a burned disc is allowed.
- If playing on a Dreamcast with a burned disc, all 3CD versions and the 1CD version from DCRes are allowed.

##### Banned Strats

- Taking long, unnecessary breaks in untimed sections such as cutscenes and upgrades could void your run.
- 3rd-party controllers are banned from use on the Dreamcast version of the game.
- If using Quick Save Reload, using the prompt reset version mid-run to skip menuing to the file selection screen in Options is not allowed.
- Some strats have a significant effect on the speedrun, and may sometimes encourage play that goes against the spirit of the category. For this reason a list of Banned Strats exists on every category’s Rules page.
- A list and explanation of every banned strat and what they mean can be found here: https://pastebin.com/qmXuGxqB
- Additionally, closing the game at any point in time to gain an advantage (besides to deactivate ESG) could void your run.
- Finally, we reserve the right to reject any run that does not technically break any rules, but does something deemed objectionable.

##### External Software

### The following mods/software are allowed for use during speedruns of all categories:

- SA2ModManager’s “Pause When Inactive”, “Disable exit prompt”, "Disable loading animation", & "Skip Intro" (in the Options tab)
- Input Displays made by Jelly & OnVar
- Autosplitters downloaded via LiveSplit or otherwise approved by moderators
- skewbmaster's SA2 Quick Save Reload mod
- Sora-yx's Error Message Fixes mod
- IDGeek121's White Jungle No Rain mod
- F-Man's 50% SFX Volume mod
- Onvar's Dreamcast deadzone fix

## Downloads to all of these can be found in the Resources tab.

### The use of Upgrade Remover, or other similar mods, is banned mid-run. If a player has acquired upgrades that they shouldn’t have at a given point, or there is other evidence of external mods/software affecting the run, the submission will be rejected.

categories.rules:
##### Goal
* Complete the listed stage during a single-segment Story run attempt.

##### Banned Strats
* Infinite Time-stop

##### Timing
* The In-Game Timer is used, and all deaths and restarts count towards your final time.

##### Submissions
* Video is required.
* Submit with only IGT.

###### For more information, see "Game Rules".

categories.name: Knuckles Centurion
categories.rules:
##### Goal

- Beat 20 of each of Knuckles' stages (Wild Canyon, Pumpkin Hill, Aquatic Mine, Death Chamber, Meteor Herd) from a Completed File, from Stage Select.  The order is up to you.

##### Banned Strats

- Chao Key Glitch
- Wrong Warps
- RNG Predict
- Exit Out Re-Rolling

##### Timing

- Time begins on selecting ‘Mission 1’ within the first Knuckles stage and ends after grabbing the 3rd piece in the last Knuckles level.
- PC Threshold: 1h 50m RTA
- Console (non-DC) Threshold: 2h 03m RTA
- DC Threshold: 2h 10m RTA

##### Submissions

- Video is required if faster than the Threshold, and submitted after August 2017.
- Submit both RTA and Loadless (Variant 2.5). 
- Do not include centisceonds/milliseconds for your RTA, but do include them for Loadless.

###### For more information, see "Game Rules".

categories.rules:

categories.name: Bi-Centurion
categories.rules:
##### Goal

- Complete both a Knuckles Centurion and a Rouge Centurion in any order.
- Knuckles Centurion consists of beating 20 of each of Knuckles' stages (Wild Canyon, Pumpkin Hill, Aquatic Mine, Death Chamber, Meteor Herd) from a Completed File, from Stage Select.
- Rouge Centurion consists of beating 25 of each of Rouge’s hunting stages (Dry Lagoon, Egg Quarters, Security Hall, Mad Space) from a Completed File, from Stage Select.
- The order of stages in each individual Centurion is up to you, however, you are not allowed to mix and match stages between Knuckles and Rouge.
- You are allowed up to 5 minutes RTA of an untimed break after completing your first Centurion to change save files/reset lives/change upgrade loadouts before starting your next Centurion.

##### Banned Strats

- Chao Key Glitch
- Wrong Warps
- RNG Predict
- Exit Out Re-Rolling

##### Timing

- The total time of the run will be a combination of your final Knuckles Centurion time and your final Rouge Centurion time. For each run time begins on selecting ‘Mission 1’ within the first Knuckles or Rouge stage and ends after grabbing the 3rd piece in the last Knuckles or Rouge stage.
- PC Threshold: 3h 50m RTA
- Console (non-DC) Threshold: 4h 16m RTA
- DC Threshold: 4h 30m RTA

##### Submissions

- Video is required if faster than the Threshold, and submitted after August 2017.
- Submit both RTA and Loadless (Variant 2.5).
- Do not include centisceonds/milliseconds for your RTA, but do include them for Loadless.

###### For more information, see "Game Rules".

categories.name: Hero Story Low%
categories.rules:
##### Goal

Complete Hero Story collecting only the following upgrades:

- Knuckles' Shovel Claws (PH)
- Tails' Booster (MSt)

##### Banned Strategies

- Exiting Certain Stages/Bosses More Than Once
- Chao Key Glitch
- Wrong Warps
- VMU Jacking

##### Timing

- Time begins on selecting 'Hero Story' and ends on the final hit of Shadow 2.
- Threshold: 50m RTA for PC, 55m RTA for Console.
- Timing Method: Loadless if faster than the Threshold, otherwise RTA.

##### Submissions

- Video is required if faster than the Threshold.
- If faster than the Threshold, submit with Loadless & RTA. If slower, submit only RTA.

###### For more information, see "Game Rules".

categories.name: Story Style
categories.rules:
##### Goal
* Complete mission 1 as fast as possible, from Story Mode or Stage Select, under New Game story mode conditions.
* Use only upgrades that you would normally have acquired in a new-game story speedrun at this point.

##### The 'Purist' Variable
Your run is Purist if all the following conditions are met:
* Only the upgrades you would normally have acquired in a new-game story speedrun are equipped at the beginning of the level.
* If the level has an intro cutscene, it was watched & the level was not restarted.
* In Radical Highway, the level was not restarted.
* In a Treasure Hunting stage, the level was not restarted.

##### Banned Strats
* Starting the Stage with Stacked Speedshoes.
* If you begin the level with the upgrade that you would normally collect in the level, you may not make use of it until you pass through its upgrade ring.
* In Pumpkin Hill & Egg Quarters, you may not collect an NG+ 3rd piece before a death after passing through the upgrade ring.
* In Eggman 1, Tails 1, Eggman 2, & Tails 2, the early charge shot may not be performed.
* In Shadow 1, Sonic 1, Egg Golem (Hero) & Egg Golem (Dark), the level may not be restarted.

##### Timing
* The In-Game Timer is used, and all deaths after collecting a checkpoint count towards your final time.
* Beginning at the start of the level through a reset or a death starts a new attempt.
* Timestop does not pause your timer.

##### Submissions
* Video is required.
* Submit with only IGT.

##### For more information, see "Game Rules".

categories.name: All Missions
categories.rules:
##### Break Guidelines
2 breaks of up to 5 minutes each are allowed.
You must mention timestamps of these breaks in your run comment.
All breaks should be taken in a menu (i.e. pause menu or emblem select menu)

categories.name: Restricted
categories.rules:
##### Goal
* Complete mission 1 as fast as possible with the omission of all the Banned Strats listed below.
* All Upgrades are allowed.

##### Banned Strats
* Starting the Stage with Stacked Speedshoes.
* Quicksand Infinite Time Stop
* PC Door Skips
* EG Superbounces
* Mech Wallruns
* Sandwalking
* OoB (non-Hunting)
* Loopspeed Launch
* Hint Monitor Clips
* Stacked Box Clips
* A list of such banned skips are in this pastebin: https://pastebin.com/6asrb2bm

##### Timing
* The In-Game Timer displayed is your final time.

##### Submissions
* Video is required.
* Submit with only IGT.

###### For more information, see "Game Rules".

games.rules:
#### Welcome to SA2B Speedrunning!

### Listed below are descriptions of concepts, terms and rules that you may need to understand each Category’s individual rulesets.

##### IGT and the Autosplitter

- Several categories are ranked based on their Time Without Loads (Loadless) as displayed by the game. 
- On PC, there is an Autosplitter that tracks your Loadless automatically. More info here: http://www.speedrun.com/sa2b/guide/fabjo
- On Console, or if you’re unable to use LiveSplit’s Autosplitter functionality, you need to calculate your Loadless manually. More info here: http://www.speedrun.com/sa2b/guide/uw9lv

##### File Types [NG/NG+]

- New Game and New Game+ are differentiated by the type of file that they are completed from. A New Game run must be completed from a Fresh File, while a New Game+ run must be completed from a Completed File.
- A “Fresh File” is a newly created File that does not have any progress made on it. In order to set up a Fresh File, one must do so in the Settings, or the File Select Screen.
- A “Completed File” is one that has already been made, and therefore already has made progress in the game. This means that any upgrades are allowed, you may start with more than 4 lives, and Stage Select can be fully unlocked, as well as any alternative Karts or Costumes.

##### Thresholds

- In order to increase the accessibility of the game’s most popular categories, video is often not required until a runner’s pb reaches a certain benchmark. Due to speedrun.com’s organization system, any run that has Loadless will be placed above every run that does not. For this reason, we remove the Loadless of all runs that do not surpass the Threshold, regardless of if they are submitted with Loadless, so that the leaderboard remains properly ordered at every rank. Each category’s Threshold can be found in their Rules.

##### Video Requirements

- Runs that require video would ideally be submitted via a website such as YouTube. Twitch VODs and Clips are allowed as well, but due to past issues YouTube is preferred.
- Please refrain from uploading your video proof to websites such as Streamable, Tiktok, Instagram, Twitter, FaceBook, etc. as they are not accessible in all regions and may get automatically deleted after some time has passed.

##### Frame Rate

- The game should be played as close to 60fps as possible. If the run has significant frame drops the Mod Team reserves the right to reject it.

##### Emulators & ISO Loading

- All emulators are banned.
- For console categories that use loadless: using a USB/SD card loader, an optical drive emulator, or playing on a burned disc is allowed.
- If playing on a Dreamcast with a burned disc, all 3CD versions and the 1CD version from DCRes are allowed.

##### Banned Strats

- Taking long, unnecessary breaks in untimed sections such as cutscenes and upgrades could void your run.
- 3rd-party controllers are banned from use on the Dreamcast version of the game.
- If using Quick Save Reload, using the prompt reset version mid-run to skip menuing to the file selection screen in Options is not allowed.
- Some strats have a significant effect on the speedrun, and may sometimes encourage play that goes against the spirit of the category. For this reason a list of Banned Strats exists on every category’s Rules page.
- A list and explanation of every banned strat and what they mean can be found here: https://pastebin.com/qmXuGxqB
- Additionally, closing the game at any point in time to gain an advantage (besides to deactivate ESG) could void your run.
- Finally, we reserve the right to reject any run that does not technically break any rules, but does something deemed objectionable.

##### External Software

### The following mods/software are allowed for use during speedruns of all categories:

- SA2ModManager’s “Pause When Inactive”, “Disable exit prompt”, "Disable loading animation", & "Skip Intro" (in the Options tab)
- Input Displays made by Jelly & OnVar
- Autosplitters downloaded via LiveSplit or otherwise approved by moderators
- skewbmaster's SA2 Quick Save Reload mod
- Sora-yx's Error Message Fixes mod
- IDGeek121's White Jungle No Rain mod
- F-Man's 50% SFX Volume mod
- Onvar's Dreamcast deadzone fix

## Downloads to all of these can be found in the Resources tab.

### The use of Upgrade Remover, or other similar mods, is banned mid-run. If a player has acquired upgrades that they shouldn’t have at a given point, or there is other evidence of external mods/software affecting the run, the submission will be rejected.

values.rules:
Restarts and deaths DO NOT count towards your final time. You are allowed to retry each boss as many times as you want, as long you stay within the restrictions of the extra lives you have when starting the boss rush. The in-game time displayed at the tally at the end of the boss rush counts.

The Hero/Dark portions of the All stories boss rush may be submitted to the Hero/Dark boss rush boards, as long as the tally at the end of the boss rush is displayed in the submission video.

All runs require video evidence. You are allowed to cut out failed attempts of bosses from the submitted video.

It is recommended, though not required, that you export your run highlight to an external site, such as YouTube, in the event of a Twitch VOD breaking. Any runs without video evidence will not remain on the leaderboards.

values.name: Single Segment Style
values.rules:
All deaths and restarts count towards your time. The final time displayed in-game at the end of the boss rush is not to be counted for these leaderboards, unless your run does not contain any deaths or restarts. If the game is paused for an excessive amount of time (such as to take a break), a run may be voided. 

Time begins on selecting the boss rush and ends when the In-Game Timer in the final boss of the boss rush stops.
